collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a carrying or nursing parent aged 18+ with a baby (where the game records it), any sex, and their partner (where the game records it)

collection.description: A tired parent is up for the third night feed when their partner stirs: the partner gets up too, or the parent lets them sleep.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It's the middle of the night, the baby is hungry for the third time, and (subject) is so tired (subject.he/she) can barely see. (subject.He/she) sits up, feeds the baby and rocks (subject.him/her)self half asleep. (friend) stirs on the other side of the hut.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) gets up, makes (subject) a warm drink, sits beside (subject.him/her) and keeps (subject.him/her) company while the baby feeds. Then (friend.he/she) takes the baby and walks up and down, humming, while (subject) sleeps. In the morning they're both exhausted. They look at each other over breakfast. "Same again tonight?" "Same again tonight." They laugh weakly. The baby is fine. So are they, more or less.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) whispers, "Go back to sleep, I've got this." (friend) does. (subject) feeds the baby and sits watching the stars through the doorway, so tired that everything feels soft and strange. The baby falls asleep. (subject) sits a while longer. It's lonely and lovely at the same time. In the morning (friend) brings (subject.him/her) breakfast in bed. Fair's fair.
